Package org.spaceinvaders.gameEngine

Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
org.spaceinvaders.gameEngine.GameEngine
public class GameEngine extends Object
GameEngine.java
The GameEngine class manages the game logic for a space invaders-like game. It is responsible for instantiating game objects (spaceships, enemies, asteroids, meteors, etc.) and updating their states. The game mechanics include movement, collisions, and physics.
Since:
11/27/2024
